title: Harry Potter Wizarding Differences
script: This is an Animagus. This is a Metamorphmagus. So what's the difference? An Animagus learns to transform into one animal. A Metamorphmagus is born with the power to shape-shift at will. This is an Auror. This is an Unspeakable. So what's the difference? An Auror hunts dark wizards in the field. An Unspeakable researches top-secret magic inside the Department of Mysteries. This is a Squib. This is a Muggle. So what's the difference? A Squib is non-magical with wizard parents. A Muggle is non-magical with non-magical parents. Follow for more.
